subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Should subagent lifecycle receipts and supervision actions extend the existing metadata-only audit/task surfaces, or use a dedicated subagent lifecycle API and table?
rationale: The remaining work adds durable state, public Gateway/API semantics, operator authorization, redaction, retention, and mutating supervision controls, so automation cannot safely choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Extend audit and task foundation
options.body: Add subagent lifecycle/action event kinds and read/write RPCs over the existing metadata-only audit, task, and subagent models.

options.title: Create dedicated subagent ledger
options.body: Add a separate subagent event table/API if lifecycle retention, ordering, or action semantics must differ from the general audit/task ledger.

options.title: Keep summaries only
options.body: Narrow or close this issue if maintainers do not want durable subagent lifecycle receipts and audited supervision controls now.

recommendation.title: Extend audit and task foundation
recommendation.body: Add subagent lifecycle/action event kinds and read/write RPCs over the existing metadata-only audit, task, and subagent models.
